import sys

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    if not data:
        return
    n_line = data[0].strip()
    if not n_line:
        return
    n = int(n_line)
    if len(data) < 2:
        s = ''
    else:
        s = data[1]  # keep original line, no strip
    if n <= 0:
        print("0 0")
        return

    s = s[:n]  # substring of length n
    length = len(s)
    pos = 0
    inside = False
    cur_len = 0
    inside_words = 0
    max_len = 0

    while pos < length:
        next_pos = length
        # find next delimiter
        t = s.find('_', pos)
        if t != -1 and t < next_pos:
            next_pos = t
        t = s.find('(', pos)
        if t != -1 and t < next_pos:
            next_pos = t
        t = s.find(')', pos)
        if t != -1 and t < next_pos:
            next_pos = t

        if pos < next_pos:
            cur_len = next_pos - pos
            if inside:
                inside_words += 1
            else:
                if cur_len > max_len:
                    max_len = cur_len
            cur_len = 0

        if next_pos < length:
            c = s[next_pos]
            if c == '(':
                inside = True
            elif c == ')':
                inside = False
            pos = next_pos + 1
        else:
            pos = length

    print(f"{max_len} {inside_words}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
